name: agent-toolworks
description: Tools for working with coding agents — measured, not asserted. Each one is built on a benchmark it can lose.

plugins.name: code-search
plugins.description: Search across many repositories at once — who calls an endpoint, where a symbol is defined, what implements an interface, which repo publishes a package, and when a cross-repo seam last changed. Routes each question to whichever of five engines can answer it, and labels every answer with the kind of evidence behind it.

plugins.name: token-save
plugins.description: Measure what an AI coding session actually costs and get advice derived from your own transcripts — where the tokens went, which were re-read on every turn, and which fixes are worth making on this machine.
